## Historical audit: S0192

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to JSONL lines and the supplied character ranges.

| Area | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Intended task | The student was asked to reconstruct an indoor RGB scene as separate 3D meshes, with matching geometry, materials, camera and framing, using SceneAct and Blender. The request included a 512 × 341 image reference and a limited execution budget. These are requested goals, not evidence of a reconstruction. [S0192, line 1, chars 0–9211] |
| Actual operations and changes | A fresh, read-only Codex student session was launched with the staged image; its recorded status was failed, exit code 1, with zero tool calls. No student program, scene edit, execution or rendered output appears in the supplied trajectory. [S0192, line 2, chars 0–2630] |
| Failure and validation | The model error reports that the student exited 1 and points to a stderr log; the scene traceback propagates that error from the model call. The stderr contents are not supplied, so the underlying cause is unknown. No render comparison, formal success or geometric validation is visible. This is a **technical interruption**, not demonstrated algorithm failure or a verified empty patch. [S0192, lines 3–4, chars 0–552 and 0–1614] |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update or execution is recorded; consequently there is no evidence of student receipt or adoption. No autonomous exploration is visible beyond the failed session; zero tool calls are reported, though underlying inference rounds are not exposed. [S0192, lines 1–4, ranges above] |
| Scene checks | The instructions require multiple separate meshes and attention to materials, placement, camera and lighting, but the supplied record does not show the reference image or a generated scene. Multiple actual objects, textures, part connections, pose, and camera/light/render issues therefore cannot be independently assessed. [S0192, line 1, chars 0–9211; line 2, chars 0–2630] |

**Transferable lesson:** distinguish a failed model-service invocation from a reconstruction algorithm’s failure; an exit code and traceback locate the interruption but do not establish its root cause. **Task-specific unresolved questions:** what the reference depicts, what stderr reported, and whether any later attempt produced a scene are not established by this record. The image path and task instructions alone do not verify visual or geometric correctness.
